does: Called by App::InitGame just before ecl::EocClient::Load: besides the loading hints (Hints/Hints.lsx into ecl::HintManager) it builds the Razer Chroma effects, creates the sound manager and runs App::InitialiseSound (the Wwise engine and its init bank), and creates the two bik::BinkManager objects (the video players' managers).

evidence.says: dx11 pseudo-code builds Path(0xb, Hints/Hints.lsx), then writes 0 to the HintManager global +0x14 and loads; Toolkit EoC.dll App::InitializeResourceManager calls ecl::HintManager::Init with the same strings
Toolkit EoC.dll+0x158610 App::InitializeResourceManager, same strings Hints/Hints.lsx and Editor/Hints/HintsEditor.lsx
EoC.dll exports this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function

copy attacks: a loose Data/Public/Game/Hints/Hints.lsx with 2 Hint nodes and HintDuration 7 gave ecl::HintManager count 2 and duration 7.0 after a restart (49 and 5.0 without it): the one file is found through the normal file lookup, so whoever shadows Public/Game/Hints/Hints.lsx last replaces the whole list

dx11 pseudo-code: the user of _ChromaLink.chroma, a 0x6E0-byte SoundManager handed to App::InitialiseSound, two 0x130-byte objects built by bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x21B5200 (bik::BinkManager's constructor by size and order, as the macOS App::InitGame inlines them: _malloc(0x128) + bik::BinkManager::BinkManager twice), then Path(0xB, Hints/Hints.lsx)

Timeline Step rows of the fork's hook (two starts): 5937.2 -> 6470.4 ms and 5044.3 -> 5496.9 ms; the process's reads grow by 240.8 MB in 4112 operations while only 21 files are opened through ls::FileReader (GameplaySoundBanks.lsf, SoundPreloadConfig.lsf, Bink.bshd, the Granite translation-table shaders, Hints/Hints.lsx last): the bulk of the start's read before InitMenu is the sound engine's own reading
